security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes to mivt CSR (0x307) to configure the M-mode trap vector base without explicitly clearing or setting the EHV bit, OR writes to mivt without a subsequent fence instruction, causing the synchronous exception hardware vectoring behavior to take effect on a stale or attacker-controlled trap vector configuration.
security_spec.summary: Unchecked EHV bit in mivt CSR allows misconfigured synchronous exception vectoring that can redirect M-mode traps to attacker-controlled addresses, breaking the M-mode trust boundary
